hook.line: Anthropic told the government you can't use our AI to kill people.
hook.visual: Extreme close-up of the creator's face talking, then at 0.67 s a cut to a medium shot with a Claude by Anthropic logo card at the top.

beats.what: Extreme close-up, mouth filling the frame, keyword 'ANTHROPIC' highlighted yellow in the caption.
Cut to a medium shot; a Claude logo card appears at the top as the subject is named.
Cut to an angled shot with open-hand gestures on the 'mass surveillance' line.
New York Times headline card about agencies being ordered to stop using Anthropic appears as proof.
Cut to green screen: creator cut out over a Huawei phone web page as he compares it to the 'Huawei treatment'.
Ends on one word, 'crazy', with no outro.

why_it_works: Hard news with a moral frame in the first sentence (AI used to kill people); stakes are clear before a second passes.
Logo and headline cards appear exactly when the company and the claim are named, so each fact has visual proof.
A familiar comparison (the Huawei treatment) with its own background makes the news easy to place.
Cinematic score under the voice (music bed -27.2 dB) makes a 24 s phone video feel like a news segment.
weaknesses: No events or punches at all (0 per minute); the last 9 s is one static green-screen background.
No CTA; high likes but few comments (527) for a provocative topic.
Opinion stated as fact with only one source card shown.
for_robert: When he names a company or claim, pop its logo or headline card at the top of the frame on that exact word; Fred can hold the card up instead of it just appearing.
